- delta-snapshot synchronization corruption,
- `AcceptSync` regressing an already-decided index,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive suffix replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

All findings, required conditions, code references, commands, and retained outputs are available in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
